d: Company Description Cherry Ventures is a growing organization focused on delivering high-quality health and wellness services to diverse communities. The company values evidence-based practice, collaboration, and continuous learning across its clinical teams. Cherry Ventures aims to create supportive environments where clients can achieve functional independence and improve their quality of life. Professionals joining the organization can expect a culture that prioritizes ethical care, professional development, and multidisciplinary teamwork.

Role Description This is a part-time, on-site Occupational Therapist role based in Manama. The Occupational Therapist will assess clients’ functional abilities, develop individualized treatment plans, and implement evidence-based interventions to support daily living, work, and leisure activities. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting evaluations, providing rehabilitation sessions, documenting progress, and collaborating with other healthcare professionals to ensure coordinated care. The role involves working with a varied caseload, including pediatric and adult clients, and educating clients, families, and caregivers on strategies to improve independence and safety. The Occupational Therapist will also participate in case discussions, contribute to program development, and maintain compliance with professional and regulatory standards.
q: Candidates should possess strong skills in Occupational Therapy and Rehabilitation to assess needs and deliver effective, client-centered interventions.
Candidates should possess foundational knowledge in Medicine to understand medical conditions, treatment plans, and their impact on functional performance.
Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and to educate clients, families, and caregivers.
Candidates should possess competencies in Pediatrics for working with children and adolescents requiring developmental or functional support.
Relevant academic qualification in Occupational Therapy (bachelor’s or master’s degree) and current licensure or eligibility for licensure in the appropriate jurisdiction.
Experience in clinical or community-based settings, with strong documentation skills and familiarity with assessment tools and treatment modalities.
Ability to work ethically and respectfully with individuals from diverse cultural and socioeconomic backgrounds.
Commitment to ongoing professional development and adherence to best practice and safety guidelines.

d: The Site Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all construction activities comply with the project's technical specifications, quality standards, safety regulations, and scheduled timelines.
Interpret and monitor project drawings and specifications to ensure construction activities align with contract requirements and Ministry/industry standards
Assist in developing method statements and ensure adherence to approved methodologies during execution
Ensure accurate survey control is established and maintained to ensure works are constructed to the correct line and level, in coordination with surveyors
Verify that all materials used on-site comply fully with project specifications
Monitor daily construction activities against approved drawings, specifications and project schedules
Prepare and submit inspection requests to the consultant and coordinate required inspections
Coordinate with utility authorities and relevant stakeholders before commencing excavation and diversion works
Monitor earthworks, compaction tests, concrete tests, asphalt testing and other required quality tests
Coordinate with specialist subcontractors, and the supply of materials and equipment
Optimize resource usage and minimize material wastage to enhance project profitability
Plan and organize work efficiently to meet project deadlines and milestones
Ensure that all construction activities are carried out in accordance with approved method statements and ITPs
Identify site constraints, technical issues and discrepancies in drawings and coordinate timely resolution
Promote and maintain a safe and healthy work environment in compliance with safety regulations
Monitor subcontractor performance, manpower productivity and equipment utilisation
Maintain daily site diaries and provide accurate progress reports to the Senior Engineer
Perform additional duties as assigned by management
Ensure that completed works are properly measured, recorded and reflected in as-built drawings
Carry out regular inspections of temporary works, including formwork, shoring, excavation support and other temporary structures, when appointed as Temporary Works Coordinator.
q: Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering or Diploma in Civil Engineering
Minimum 3-5 years' experience in the construction industry working for a Contractor, with Bahrain or GCC experience preferably

Experience in a site engineer role on new road infrastructure projects including technical responsibility for asphalt laying, road base, sub-base, kerbstones, paving, drainage installation and utility reinstatement and diversions
Demonstrated effective communication, and sound decision-making abilities
Proficient in a range of computer applications relevant to engineering and project management
